description: This file defines types and functions related to managing and resolving issues with matrix room key backups, including determining backup status and readiness errors.

methods.name: resolveMatrixRoomKeyBackupIssue
methods.description: Determines the specific issue with the matrix room key backup based on its status.

methods.name: resolveMatrixRoomKeyBackupReadinessError
methods.description: Provides a user-friendly error message if the backup is not ready or usable.
